patch.objective: Recognize rising intracranial pressure: headache, vomiting, falling level of consciousness and Cushing's triad

sources.note: Relayed from the LPN/VN course's earlier cases (read 2026-11-11, primary PDF), not re-read for this band: the practical nursing course is built toward this test plan.
The objective and secondary objectives are the course's own titles.

Relayed from the NCLEX-PN case head-strike-on-apixaban, not re-read for this band; its note: Relayed from the REQ-233 NCLEX-PN cases (read 2026-11-11, primary PDF), not re-read: Physiological Adaptation and Reduction of Risk Potential include recognizing and reporting changes in the client's condition; Coordinated Care includes care within the legal scope of practice.

sources.cite: Pinto VL, Adeyinka A. Increased Intracranial Pressure. StatPearls (updated 2025-09-14), NCBI Bookshelf NBK482119
sources.note: Relayed from the NCLEX-PN case head-strike-on-apixaban, not re-read for this band; its note: Read 2026-11-16 through a summarizing fetch with quotes: suspect raised intracranial pressure with 'headaches, vomiting, and altered mental status varying from drowsiness to coma'; 'Cushing triad is a clinical syndrome consisting of hypertension, bradycardia, and irregular respiration', 'a late and ominous sign of impending herniation'; 'Early recognition and intervention are vital to prevent life-threatening complications such as brain herniation'; such patients are managed in intensive care.

sources.cite: NICE guideline NG232, Head injury: assessment and early management (2023), recommendation 1.5.13 as reproduced by St Emlyn's
sources.note: Relayed from the NCLEX-PN case head-strike-on-apixaban, not re-read for this band; its note: Relayed from the REQ-223 CNA fall case (read 2026-11-10 through a secondary summary), not re-read: for people on anticoagulants (including DOACs) with a head injury, consider a CT head scan within 8 hours. FLAG: a UK guideline through a summary; used only for why a head strike on a blood thinner is an emergency to report, not for a timing in this case.
